newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH '96 TIMBER CUTTINGS DOWN 11 PCT - METLA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH '96 TIMBER CUTTINGS DOWN 11 PCT - METLA.

text.p: Raw timber cuttings in Finnish forests fell 11 percent year-on-year to 45.8 million cubic metres, the Finnish Forest Research Institute (METLA) said in a monthly review on Tuesday.
"Monthly cuttings were lower than average in February-July and in December 1996," Metla said.
Metla said raw timber cuttings in December were 4.5 million cubic metres.
"The amount was up three percent year-on-year but two percent below the average," it added.
